title: The Endless Exam: Mathematical Constructions from Today's Models toward Superintelligence
abstract: arXiv:2609.24555v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce the Endless Exam, a benchmark for measuring mathematical progress from today's models toward artificial superintelligence through fourteen parameterised construction families. Each submitted object is checked automatically for validity and assigned a relative quality score against a published frontier or construction baseline, without capping improvements at $1$. The families draw on open mathematical problems for long-term targets and generate new instances at larger parameters, where compact certificates keep large constructions verifiable. Across eight models evaluated on 69 distinct instances, continuous quality scores distinguish performance even though no evaluated system surpasses a published frontier. Size-quality curves show how construction quality changes as problem size increases. translated_title: 无尽考试：从当今模型迈向超级智能的数学构造
translated_abstract: 我们提出了“无尽考试”，这是一个通过十四个参数化构造族来衡量当今模型向人工超级智能发展的数学进展的基准。每个提交的对象都会自动进行有效性检查，并根据已发表的前沿结果或构造基线分配相对质量分数，且不将改进上限设为1。这些构造族以开放数学问题作为长期目标，并在更大参数下生成新实例，其中紧凑的证书使大型构造保持可验证性。在69个不同实例上对八个模型进行评估，连续质量分数即使在没有任何被评估系统超越已发表前沿的情况下，也能有效区分各系统的性能。规模-质量曲线展示了构造质量如何随问题规模的增大而变化。我们发布了生成器、验证器、参考资料、模型响应和分析结果，以支持在达到人类水平之前及之后的持续测量。
tldr: 提出“无尽考试”基准，通过十四个参数化数学构造族自动验证并连续评分模型生成的数学构造，从而持续衡量AI从当前水平向超级智能发展的数学进步。
en_tdlr: Introduces the Endless Exam, a benchmark with fourteen parameterized mathematical construction families that automatically verifies and continuously scores model-generated constructions, enabling ongoing measurement of AI mathematical progress from today's models toward superintelligence.
